description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of languages used in OpenAssistant conversations, with the largest segment being English at 31.4%, followed by Spanish at 31.4%, and then Russian at 5.7%. The remaining languages are grouped under a single "Other" category, which accounts for 5.8% of the total. Within this "Other" category, individual languages are listed with their respective percentages: Catalan (1.6%), Portuguese (Brazil) (1.7%), Thai (1.9%), Chinese (2.5%), French (2.9%), and German (3.6%). The chart visually separates the "Other" category from the individual languages by using a lighter shade of blue and placing the labels in a radial arrangement around the center. The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are clearly associated with their corresponding segments. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest segments (English and Spanish) occupying the bottom half of the chart, and the smaller segments radiating upward from the center.
